C-REVIEW-CATALOG.IntentSummary: Complete the approved catalogue roadmap in release order and measure first-pass and repeat reviews on pinned projects.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Pin three project types and document expected evidence, acceptable exclusions and comparison measures before rubric calibration.

T-002.Title: Implement delivery, integration and specialized review methods

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Methods define evidence, applicability, false positives and unique ownership for all supported selections.

T-003.Title: Route repository choices and report external assessments

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Every requested selection is discoverable, owner reviews are deduplicated and external-only selection has no numeric score. Existing reports and selective repeats still work.

T-004.Title: Exercise the installed entry points, compare outcomes and publish verified release

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Review initial and repeated outcomes on the pinned cases, report limits, pass release checks and verify the distributed skill.
